import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 12))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 3, hspace=0.3, wspace=0.3)

# Set style
sns.set_palette("husl")

# 1. Sleep Duration vs Quality of Sleep by Gender
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 0])
for gender in df['Gender'].unique():
    data = df[df['Gender'] == gender]
    ax1.scatter(data['Sleep Duration'], data['Quality of Sleep'], 
                label=gender, alpha=0.6, s=100)
ax1.set_xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_title('Sleep Duration vs Quality', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.legend()
ax1.grid(alpha=0.3)

# 2. Age Distribution
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 1])
ax2.hist(df['Age'], bins=10, color='skyblue', edgecolor='black', alpha=0.7)
ax2.set_xlabel('Age', fontsize=10)
ax2.set_ylabel('Frequency', fontsize=10)
ax2.set_title('Age Distribution', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.grid(alpha=0.3, axis='y')

# 3. Stress Level vs Physical Activity
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2])
ax3.scatter(df['Physical Activity Level'], df['Stress Level'], 
            c=df['Age'], cmap='viridis', s=100, alpha=0.6)
ax3.set_xlabel('Physical Activity Level', fontsize=10)
ax3.set_ylabel('Stress Level', fontsize=10)
ax3.set_title('Stress vs Physical Activity', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
cbar = plt.colorbar(ax3.collections[0], ax=ax3)
cbar.set_label('Age', fontsize=9)
ax3.grid(alpha=0.3)

# 4. BMI Category Distribution
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
bmi_counts = df['BMI Category'].value_counts()
colors = sns.color_palette("Set2", len(bmi_counts))
ax4.bar(bmi_counts.index, bmi_counts.values, color=colors, edgecolor='black', alpha=0.7)
ax4.set_xlabel('BMI Category', fontsize=10)
ax4.set_ylabel('Count', fontsize=10)
ax4.set_title('BMI Category Distribution', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax4.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)
ax4.grid(alpha=0.3, axis='y')

# 5. Sleep Disorder Distribution
ax5 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])
sleep_disorder = df['Sleep Disorder'].fillna('None')
disorder_counts = sleep_disorder.value_counts()
colors = sns.color_palette("Set3", len(disorder_counts))
ax5.pie(disorder_counts.values, labels=disorder_counts.index, autopct='%1.1f%%',
        colors=colors, startangle=90)
ax5.set_title('Sleep Disorder Distribution', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')

# 6. Occupation Distribution
ax6 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 2])
occ_counts = df['Occupation'].value_counts()
colors = sns.color_palette("pastel", len(occ_counts))
ax6.barh(occ_counts.index, occ_counts.values, color=colors, edgecolor='black', alpha=0.7)
ax6.set_xlabel('Count', fontsize=10)
ax6.set_ylabel('Occupation', fontsize=10)
ax6.set_title('Occupation Distribution', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax6.grid(alpha=0.3, axis='x')

# 7. Heart Rate vs Daily Steps
ax7 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 0])
scatter = ax7.scatter(df['Daily Steps'], df['Heart Rate'], 
                      c=df['Sleep Duration'], cmap='coolwarm', s=100, alpha=0.6)
ax7.set_xlabel('Daily Steps', fontsize=10)
ax7.set_ylabel('Heart Rate (bpm)', fontsize=10)
ax7.set_title('Heart Rate vs Daily Steps', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
cbar = plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=ax7)
cbar.set_label('Sleep Duration', fontsize=9)
ax7.grid(alpha=0.3)

# 8. Average metrics by BMI Category
ax8 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 1])
bmi_groups = df.groupby('BMI Category')[['Sleep Duration', 'Quality of Sleep', 'Stress Level']].mean()
x = np.arange(len(bmi_groups.index))
width = 0.25
ax8.bar(x - width, bmi_groups['Sleep Duration'], width, label='Sleep Duration', alpha=0.8)
ax8.bar(x, bmi_groups['Quality of Sleep'], width, label='Quality of Sleep', alpha=0.8)
ax8.bar(x + width, bmi_groups['Stress Level'], width, label='Stress Level', alpha=0.8)
ax8.set_xlabel('BMI Category', fontsize=10)
ax8.set_ylabel('Average Value', fontsize=10)
ax8.set_title('Average Metrics by BMI', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax8.set_xticks(x)
ax8.set_xticklabels(bmi_groups.index, rotation=45, ha='right')
ax8.legend(fontsize=8)
ax8.grid(alpha=0.3, axis='y')

# 9. Correlation Heatmap
ax9 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 2])
numeric_cols = ['Age', 'Sleep Duration', 'Quality of Sleep', 'Physical Activity Level', 
                'Stress Level', 'Heart Rate', 'Daily Steps']
corr_matrix = df[numeric_cols].corr()
sns.heatmap(corr_matrix, annot=True, fmt='.2f', cmap='coolwarm', 
            center=0, square=True, ax=ax9, cbar_kws={'shrink': 0.8})
ax9.set_title('Correlation Matrix', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax9.tick_params(axis='both', labelsize=8)

plt.suptitle('Sleep Health and Lifestyle Dataset Analysis', 
             fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
